values.name: Price list number
values.description: Price list number Reference number assigned to a price list.

values.name: Purchase order response number
values.description: Purchase order response number Reference number assigned by the seller to an order response.

values.name: Purchase order change number
values.description: Purchase order change number Reference number assigned by a buyer for a revision of a purchase order.

values.name: Payment reference
values.description: Payment reference Reference number assigned to a payment.

values.name: Price quote number
values.description: Price quote number Reference number assigned by the seller to a quote.

values.name: Purchase order number suffix
values.description: Purchase order number suffix A number added at the end of a purchase order number.

values.name: Prior purchase order number
values.description: Prior purchase order number Reference number of a purchase order previously sent to the supplier.

values.name: Payee's financial institution account number
values.description: Payee's financial institution account number Receiving company account number (ACH transfer), check, draft or wire.

values.name: Remittance advice number
values.description: Remittance advice number A number that identifies a remittance advice.

values.name: Rail/road routing code
values.description: Rail/road routing code International Western and Eastern European route code used in all rail organizations and specified in the international tariffs (rail tariffs) known by the customers.

values.name: Railway consignment note number
values.description: Railway consignment note number Reference number assigned to a rail consignment note, see: 1001 = 720.

values.name: Release number
values.description: Release number Reference number assigned to identify a release of a set of rules, conventions, conditions, etc.

values.name: Consignment receipt identifier
values.description: Consignment receipt identifier [1150] Reference number assigned to identify a consignment upon its arrival at its destination.

values.name: Export reference number
values.description: Export reference number Reference number given to an export shipment.

values.name: Payer's financial institution transit routing No.(ACH
values.description: Payer's financial institution transit routing No.(ACH transfers) ODFI (ACH transfer).

values.name: Payee's financial institution transit routing No.
values.description: Payee's financial institution transit routing No. RDFI Transit routing number (ACH transfer).

values.name: Sales person number
values.description: Sales person number Identification number of a sales person.

values.name: Sales region number
values.description: Sales region number A number that identifies a sales region.

values.name: Sales department number
values.description: Sales department number A number that identifies a sales department.

values.name: Serial number
values.description: Serial number Identification number of an item which distinguishes this specific item out of an number of identical items.

values.name: Allocated seat
values.description: Allocated seat Reference to a seat allocated to a passenger.

values.name: Ship from
values.description: Ship from A number that identifies a ship from location.

values.name: Previous highest schedule number
values.description: Previous highest schedule number Number of the latest schedule of a previous period (ODETTE DELINS).

values.name: SID (Shipper's identifying number for shipment)
values.description: SID (Shipper's identifying number for shipment) A number that identifies the SID (shipper's identification) number for a shipment.

values.name: Sales office number
values.description: Sales office number A number that identifies a sales office.

values.name: Transport equipment seal identifier
values.description: Transport equipment seal identifier [9308] The identification number of a seal affixed to a piece of transport equipment.

values.name: Scan line
values.description: Scan line A number that identifies a scan line.

values.name: Equipment sequence number
values.description: Equipment sequence number A temporary reference number identifying a particular piece of equipment within a series of pieces of equipment.

values.name: Shipment reference number
values.description: Shipment reference number Reference number assigned to a shipment.

values.name: Sellers reference number
values.description: Sellers reference number Reference number assigned to a transaction by the seller.

values.name: Station reference number
values.description: Station reference number International UIC code assigned to every European rail station (CIM convention).

values.name: Swap order number
values.description: Swap order number Number assigned by the seller to a swap order (see definition of DE 1001, code 229).

values.name: Specification number
values.description: Specification number Number assigned by the issuer to his specification.

values.name: Trucker's bill of lading
values.description: Trucker's bill of lading A cargo list/description issued by a motor carrier of freight.

values.name: Terminal operator's consignment reference
values.description: Terminal operator's consignment reference Reference assigned to a consignment by the terminal operator.

values.name: Telex message number
values.description: Telex message number Reference number identifying a telex message.

values.name: Transfer number
values.description: Transfer number An extra number assigned to goods or a container which functions as a reference number or as an authorization number to get the goods or container released from a certain party.

values.name: TIR carnet number
values.description: TIR carnet number Reference number assigned to a TIR carnet.

values.name: Transport instruction number
values.description: Transport instruction number Reference number identifying a transport instruction.

values.name: Tax exemption licence number
values.description: Tax exemption licence number Number assigned by the tax authorities to a party indicating its tax exemption authorization. This number could relate to a specified business type, a specified local area or a class of products.

values.name: Transaction reference number
values.description: Transaction reference number Reference applied to a transaction between two or more parties over a defined life cycle; e.g. number applied by importer or broker to obtain release from Customs, may then used to control declaration through final accounting (synonyms: declaration, entry number).

values.name: Test report number
values.description: Test report number Reference number identifying a test report document relevant to the product.

values.name: Upper number of range
values.description: Upper number of range Upper number in a range of numbers.

values.name: Ultimate customer's reference number
values.description: Ultimate customer's reference number The originator's reference number as forwarded in a sequence of parties involved.

values.name: Unique consignment reference number
values.description: Unique consignment reference number [1202] Unique reference identifying a particular consignment of goods. Synonym: UCR, UCRN.

values.name: United Nations Dangerous Goods identifier
values.description: United Nations Dangerous Goods identifier [7124] United Nations Dangerous Goods Identifier (UNDG) is the unique serial number assigned within the United Nations to substances and articles contained in a list of the dangerous goods most commonly carried.

values.name: Ultimate customer's order number
values.description: Ultimate customer's order number The originator's order number as forwarded in a sequence of parties involved.

values.name: VAT registration number
values.description: VAT registration number Unique number assigned by the relevant tax authority to identify a party for use in relation to Value Added Tax (VAT).

values.name: Vendor contract number
values.description: Vendor contract number Number assigned by the vendor to a contract.

values.name: Vessel identifier
values.description: Vessel identifier (8123) Reference identifying a vessel.

values.name: Order number (vendor)
values.description: Order number (vendor) Reference number assigned by supplier to a buyer's purchase order.

values.name: Voyage number
values.description: Voyage number (8028) Reference number assigned to the voyage of the vessel.

values.name: Vendor product number
values.description: Vendor product number Number assigned by vendor to another manufacturer's product.

values.name: Vendor ID number
values.description: Vendor ID number A number that identifies a vendor's identification.

values.name: Vendor order number suffix
values.description: Vendor order number suffix The suffix for a vendor order number.

values.name: Motor vehicle identification number
values.description: Motor vehicle identification number (8213) Reference identifying a motor vehicle used for transport. Normally is the vehicle registration number.

values.name: Voucher number
values.description: Voucher number Reference number identifying a voucher.

values.name: Warehouse entry number
values.description: Warehouse entry number Entry number under which imported merchandise was placed in a Customs bonded warehouse.

values.name: Weight agreement number
values.description: Weight agreement number A number identifying a weight agreement.

values.name: Well number
values.description: Well number A number assigned to a shaft sunk into the ground.

values.name: Warehouse receipt number
values.description: Warehouse receipt number A number identifying a warehouse receipt.

values.name: Warehouse storage location number
values.description: Warehouse storage location number A number identifying a warehouse storage location.

values.name: Rail waybill number
values.description: Rail waybill number The number on a rail waybill.

values.name: Company/place registration number
values.description: Company/place registration number Company registration and place as legally required.

values.name: Cargo control number
values.description: Cargo control number Reference used to identify and control a carrier and consignment from initial entry into a country until release of the cargo by Customs.

values.name: Previous cargo control number
values.description: Previous cargo control number Where a consignment is deconsolidated and/or transferred to the control of another carrier or freight forwarder (e.g. housebill, abstract) this references the previous (e.g. master) cargo control number.

values.name: Mutually defined reference number
values.description: Mutually defined reference number Number based on party agreement.
